gui.florafare.config.exclusions.descript: Anything listed here is left entirely alone: Florafare grants it no buff even if a datapack defines one, does not change its hunger values, does not touch its tooltip or the journal, and lets its own vanilla effects fire. Use it next to another food mod that already handles its own dishes. The last list does the opposite and wins: it claims items back out of the #florafare:ignored tag, which a datapack cannot subtract from.
gui.florafare.config.ignored_food_mods.t: One mod id per line, e.g. loot_n_explore. Every food that mod adds is left alone.
One rule per line: an item (modid:item), a whole mod (modid:*), or an item tag (#namespace:tag). A pack can also fill the #florafare:ignored tag instead.
One rule per line, same syntax. Florafare manages these even though something excluded them — this is how you take a single item back out of the #florafare:ignored tag.

command.florafare.help.title: §6Florafare — guide
command.florafare.help.intro: Food carries buffs. You can hold %s at once. Pick a topic:
command.florafare.help.unknown_topic: No help topic called '%s'. Run /florafarehelp for the list.
command.florafare.help.buffs.short: eating, buff slots, how long they last
command.florafare.help.buffs.title: §6Florafare · buffs
command.florafare.help.buffs.l1: Eating a food grants its buff and takes one slot on the overlay.
command.florafare.help.buffs.l2: One slot per food item. Eating the same item again restarts its timer instead of taking a second slot.
command.florafare.help.buffs.l3: A buff can carry several status effects and several attribute changes at once — that is one buff, in one slot.
command.florafare.help.buffs.l4: When every slot is taken, a new food grants no buff. The food is still eaten and still feeds you.
command.florafare.help.buffs.l5: Buffs are lost on death. Journal discoveries and synergies are not.
command.florafare.help.buffs.l6: Forgotten Mead drops your newest buff, for when you want a slot back early.
command.florafare.help.journal.title: §6Florafare · journal
command.florafare.help.journal.l1: Every food you eat for the first time is recorded in the Food Journal.
command.florafare.help.journal.l2: Until then its buff is hidden from the tooltip — the journal is a record of what you have actually tried.
command.florafare.help.journal.l3: The journal is craftable, and new players are given one on first join.
command.florafare.help.journal.l4: Discoveries survive death and are saved as you make them, not only at logout.
command.florafare.help.synergies.short: buff combinations and what they need
command.florafare.help.synergies.title: §6Florafare · synergies
command.florafare.help.synergies.l1: Holding the right buffs together activates a synergy — an extra effect on top of them.
command.florafare.help.synergies.l2: A synergy lasts as long as the shortest buff feeding it, and ends the moment one of them does.
command.florafare.help.synergies.l3: Synergies are found by experimenting; the journal records each one you trigger.
command.florafare.help.synergies.l4: A synergy needing more buffs than you have slots can never fire — operators can check that with /florafare validate.
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.shor: "I ate something and got no buff"
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.titl: §6Florafare · why did my bite do nothing
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.l1: 1. Every buff slot was full. The action bar says so; free one by waiting or drinking Forgotten Mead.
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.l2: 2. That food is on the ignore list — another mod owns it, and Florafare leaves it alone entirely.
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.l3: 3. You already had that exact item's buff; eating it again restarts the timer rather than adding a slot.
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.l4: 4. The server was restarted while the buff was running. Buffs are saved, but the last few seconds before a crash can be lost.
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.l5: An operator can answer it exactly with /florafare explain, holding the food.
command.florafare.help.troubleshoot.l6: If a stat feels stuck after a relog, /florafare repair <player> clears any leftover modifier.
command.florafare.help.edit.short: §eop§7 · retune a food without a restart
command.florafare.help.edit.title: §6Florafare · /florafare edit
command.florafare.help.edit.l1: Changes what a food does, live, with no datapack edit and no /reload.
command.florafare.help.edit.l2: /florafare edit minecraft:bread duration 2400 — fields: duration (ticks), nutrition, saturation, health, priority, always_edible.
command.florafare.help.edit.l3: /florafare edit minecraft:bread effect add minecraft:regeneration 200 1 — add as many effects as you like; also attribute add <id> <amount> [operation].
command.florafare.help.edit.l4: Targets: an item id, tag <namespace:path> for an item tag (no leading #), namespace:<modid>, or template:default.
command.florafare.help.edit.l5: Editing an item that inherits its buff from a tag writes an entry for that item alone and leaves the tag as it was.
command.florafare.help.edit.l6: Saved into the world, re-sent to everyone online, and kept through /reload and restarts.
command.florafare.help.edit.l7: /florafare edit list · <target> show · <target> reset · reset all
command.florafare.help.ignore.short: §eop§7 · keep Florafare away from an item or mod
command.florafare.help.ignore.title: §6Florafare · /florafare ignore
command.florafare.help.ignore.l1: An ignored item is invisible to Florafare: no buff, no tooltip, no journal row, vanilla behaviour untouched.
command.florafare.help.ignore.l3: /florafare ignore add inventory [<player>] ignores every food being carried, for when another mod's whole menu is in front of you.
command.florafare.help.ignore.l4: /florafare ignore remove <entry> hands something back, even when a tag or another mod excluded it.
command.florafare.help.ignore.l5: Takes effect on the next bite, re-syncs every client, and is written to config/florafare.json.
command.florafare.help.admin.short: §eop§7 · the rest of the operator commands
command.florafare.help.admin.title: §6Florafare · operator commands
command.florafare.help.admin.l1: /florafare buffs <player> — what they have running, with the modifiers actually applied.
command.florafare.help.admin.l3: /florafare explain [<item>] — why this item has that buff, every entry that could have applied, and why the others lost.
command.florafare.help.admin.l4: /florafare validate — synergies that can never fire, dead requirements, same-priority ties.
command.florafare.help.admin.l5: /florafare setbuff ... — stamps a buff onto the stack in your hand only. For changing a food for everyone, use /florafare edit.
